assumptions.memory_conversion: EXPERIMENTAL assumption: one normalized memory unit equals 64 GiB; not supplied by Alibaba or derived from SPEC RAM.
assumptions.bandwidth: EXPERIMENTAL assumption: independent 125 MB/s link per concurrent transfer; Brave stop-and-copy model.
assumptions.lr: Tricube-weighted local linear CPU forecast over last 10 control samples; CPU safety 1.2; common static memory guard at 0.9.
assumptions.placement: Only the placement score differs between the two LR-MMT variants; control, admission, conversion, power and migration mechanics are shared.
